metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature in New Mexico higher on July 20-27, 2016 than the 2001-2010 average for the same period?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS LST (MOD11A1 or MOD11A2) for land surface temperature - Date: July 20-27, 2016 vs. July 20-27 averaged over 2001-2010 - Location: New Mexico state boundary 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS LST has QC bands - should apply quality masking to remove poor quality pixels - Not about clouds directly, but data quality is important 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid LST should be in reasonable range (e.g., 250-350 Kelvin or -23 to 77°C) - Zero or None indicates C3 - Check pixel counts to detect C2 - Check collection size to detect C1 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define New Mexico geometry const newMexico = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'New Mexico')) .geometry(); // 2. Function to mask low quality MODIS LST pixels function maskLST(image) { const qa = image.select('QC_Day'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1); // Keep only good quality (0,1) return image.select('LST_Day_1km').updateMask(mask); } // 3. Get 2016 data (July 20-27) const lst2016 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate('2016-07-20', '2016-07-28') .filterBounds(newMexico) .map(maskLST); const size2016 = lst2016.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2016 Images: ${size2016}`); if (size2016 === 0) { console.log('No data for 2016.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Get 2001-2010 average for July 20-27 let allYears = []; for (let year = 2001; year <= 2010; year++) { const yearCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate(`${year}-07-20`, `${year}-07-28`) .filterBounds(newMexico) .map(maskLST); allYears.push(yearCol); } const lstHistorical = ee.ImageCollection(allYears.flat()); const sizeHistorical = lstHistorical.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2001-2010 Images: ${sizeHistorical}`); if (sizeHistorical === 0) { console.log('No data for 2001-2010.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Calculate means const mean2016 = lst2016.mean(); const meanHistorical = lstHistorical.mean(); // 6. Check pixel counts const count2016 = mean2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: newMexico, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); const countHistorical = meanHistorical.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: newMexico, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); console.log(`2016 Valid Pixels: ${count2016}`); console.log(`2001-2010 Valid Pixels: ${countHistorical}`); if (count2016 === 0 || countHistorical === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 7. Calculate average LST values (in Kelvin, scale factor 0.02) const val2016 = mean2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: newMexico, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); const valHistorical = meanHistorical.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: newMexico, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); if (val2016 === null || valHistorical === null) { console.log('Calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Convert to Celsius (scale factor 0.02, subtract 273.15) const temp2016 = val2016 * 0.02 - 273.15; const tempHistorical = valHistorical * 0.02 - 273.15; console.log(`2016 Mean LST: ${temp2016.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`2001-2010 Mean LST: ${tempHistorical.toFixed(2)}°C`); // 8. Validate temperature range if (temp2016 < -50 || temp2016 > 70 || tempHistorical < -50 || tempHistorical > 70) { console.log('Invalid temperature range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 9. Compare if (temp2016 > tempHistorical) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
